+def test_DisplaySend_dispatch_and_deduplicate(monkeypatch, capsys):
+    from ansible.executor.task_queue_manager import DisplaySend, FinalQueue
+    from ansible.plugins import strategy
+
+    display = Display()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(display, '_final_q', None)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(display, '_warns', {})
+    monkeypatch.setattr(display, '_deprecations', {})
+
+    messages = []
+    sender = MagicMock()
+    sender.put.side_effect = messages.append
+    FinalQueue.send_display(sender, 'warning', 'shared warning')
+    FinalQueue.send_display(sender, 'warning', 'shared warning')
+    FinalQueue.send_display(sender, 'deprecated', 'shared deprecation', version='2.0')
+    FinalQueue.send_display(sender, 'deprecated', 'shared deprecation', version='2.0')
+    assert all(isinstance(item, DisplaySend) for item in messages)
+    assert messages[0].method == 'warning'
+    assert messages[0].args == ('shared warning',)
+    assert messages[0].kwargs == {}
+    assert messages[2].method == 'deprecated'
+    assert messages[2].kwargs == {'version': '2.0'}
+
+    receiver = MagicMock()
+    receiver._final_q.get.side_effect = messages + [strategy.StrategySentinel()]
+    strategy.results_thread_main(receiver)
+
+    out, err = capsys.readouterr()
+    assert out == ''
+    assert err.count('[WARNING]: shared warning') == 1
+    assert err.count('[DEPRECATION WARNING]: shared deprecation') == 1
+
+
 def test_Display_display_lock(monkeypatch):
     lock = MagicMock()
     display = Display()
